source: That’s truly unfortunate… I was certain that Mr. Nomoru would accept this offer.
translation: 真遗憾……我本以为Nomoru先生会接受这项提议。

source: I hope you understand, Mr. Clermont, but we’re more than satisfied with the state of Camp Buddy.
translation: 希望您能理解，Clermont先生，但我们对 Camp Buddy 的现状已经十分满意。

source: We also believe that it will allow us to maintain the spirit and quality of the camp better than we otherwise could.
translation: 我们也相信，只有这样才能更好地保持营地一贯的精神与品质。

source: Well, it sounds like he’s fully made up his mind! I won’t try and convince you all any further!
translation: 嗯，听起来他已经完全下定决心！我不会再试图说服你们！

source: Consider it an open opportunity should Mr. Nomoru ever change his mind.
translation: 如果Nomoru先生以后改变主意，这个机会随时为他保留。

source: I really appreciate your generosity, Mr. Clermont. Thank you for giving us a chance.
translation: 我真的很感谢您的慷慨，Clermont先生。谢谢您给我们机会。

source: Whew…! That’s done!
translation: 呼……！处理完了！

source: I think we settled it in the best way possible, Goro. Now I’m glad it’ll finally be off your chest!
translation: 我想我们已经用最妥当的方式解决了，Goro。你心里的这块石头总算能落地了！

source: I still feel guilty about all this… And you even had to make the call, too…
translation: 我仍对这一切感到愧疚……而且你甚至还得亲自打电话……

source: Like I told you, I’ll try and take over more things from now on! You don’t have to worry about a single thing!
translation: 就像我告诉你的，从现在起我会努力接手更多事情！你什么都不用担心！

source: I think this is a good start if we’re really planning on easing the work away from you!
translation: 如果我们真的打算减轻你的工作，我想这是个好的开始！

source: Well… I still am serious about completing the project at least.
translation: 嗯……至少我仍然认真想完成这个项目。

source: Well, there’s not too much of that left! It’ll only take a few more months until we’re completely done!
translation: 嗯，剩下的也不多了！再过几个月我们就能完全完成！

source: All of a sudden, I’m doubting if this was the right decision…
translation: 突然间，我怀疑这是否是正确决定……

source: *sigh* You must still be thinking you have to be responsible for everyone…
translation: *叹气* 你一定还在想自己必须对每个人负责……

source: I am… It’s what I’ve done for so long… It’s pretty much hard-wired into me.
translation: 是的……我这么做太久了……这几乎已经根植于我。

source: And it just felt so surreal turning down something I spent my whole life working towards…
translation: 而拒绝一件我花费整个人生努力追求的事，感觉实在太不真实了……

source: After the first term, I kept building up the camp until it had grown and spread.
translation: 第一期之后，我不断建设营地，直到它成长并扩张。

source: Then I found myself managing several branches at once, and I used them as an excuse to shut away my pain, and fill the emptiness in my heart.
translation: 后来我发现自己同时管理多个分部，并把它们当成封闭痛苦、填补内心空虚的借口。

source: I lost myself along the way, and despite expanding the camp to what I thought was successful, all of it became meaningless…
translation: 我在这过程中迷失了自己，尽管把营地扩张到我以为成功的程度，一切都变得毫无意义……

source: And yet you pushed yourself throughout this project too…
translation: 然而你在整个项目中也逼迫自己不断前进……

source: If only I had known sooner, I could’ve at least taken some of the load off of you…
translation: 如果我能早点知道，至少能替你分担一些负担……

source: Honestly, I was so distracted by our time together…
translation: 说实话，我们在一起的时光让我如此分心……

source: Every moment I spent outside of work, it made me realize what I had been missing out on for so long…
translation: 我在工作之外度过的每一刻，都让我意识到自己长久以来错过了什么……

source: But now, you finally get to start over! And for real, this time!
translation: 但现在，你终于能重新开始！而且这次是真的！

source: I don’t know what I’ll do yet… But regardless, thank you for supporting my decision, Yoshinori.
translation: 我还不知道自己要做什么……但无论如何，谢谢你支持我的决定，Yoshinori。

source: Of course, Goro…
translation: 当然，Goro……

source: Ah, there you are, Dad!
translation: 啊，你在这里，爸爸！

source: Good morning, Yuri.
translation: 早上好，Yuri。

source: Don’t ‘good morning’ me! You’ve got a lot of explaining to do!
translation: 别跟我说“早上好”！你有很多事要解释！

source: What was that all about yesterday? Did you really turn down Mr. Clermont’s offer?!
translation: 昨天那到底是怎么回事？你真的拒绝了 Clermont先生 的提议？！

source: Yes… In fact, Yoshinori just called him earlier to confirm it…
translation: 是的……事实上，Yoshinori 刚才给他打电话确认过……

source: Wh-Why…?
translation: 为、为什么……？

source: Well, dear… I’m sure you remember how we tried this together before…
translation: 嗯，亲爱的……我相信你记得我们以前如何一起尝试过这件事……

source: You saw how difficult and inefficient things were because we weren’t prepared.
translation: 你看到了，因为我们没有准备，事情有多困难、多低效。

source: And after experiencing what we all thought was the peak of Camp Buddy, it turns out it wasn’t really a good thing.
translation: 而在经历了我们都以为是 Camp Buddy 巅峰的时期后，结果发现那其实并非好事。

source: All I’m saying is that we should be content with where all of us are now…
translation: 我想说的只是，我们应该满足于我们所有人现在的位置……

source: We don’t need anything more than what we already have…
translation: 我们不需要比已经拥有的更多……

source: I understand, Dad…
translation: 我明白了，爸爸……

source: Honestly, I’d hate to risk seeing you at your worst again…
translation: 说实话，我不愿冒险再次看到你最糟糕的样子……

source: We’ve come such a long way just to fix things and return to how it was when we started…
translation: 我们走了这么长的路，只是为了修复事情，回到最初的样子……

source: I’m relieved you see it too, dear.
translation: 我很欣慰你也看到了这一点，亲爱的。

source: *sigh* You can just be so reckless sometimes, you know?
translation: *叹气* 你有时真的会很鲁莽，知道吗？

source: I mean… You could’ve just told us that to begin with!
translation: 我是说……你一开始就可以告诉我们这些！

source: Yes… I’m sorry. I had to sort things out with Yoshinori first before I could tell everyone.
translation: 是的……对不起。我必须先和 Yoshinori 理清事情，才能告诉所有人。

source: Speaking of that! You two came home so late last night… and with a motorcycle too!
translation: 说到这个！你们两个昨晚那么晚回家……而且还是骑着摩托车！

source: You have to explain it to everyone else! They wouldn’t stop asking me what was going on all morning!
translation: 你们必须向其他人解释！整个早上他们不停问我发生了什么！

source: I think everyone’s at the mess hall having breakfast. Maybe we should take the chance to talk before work begins today.
translation: 我想大家都在食堂吃早餐。也许我们该抓住机会在今天工作开始前谈谈。

source: You’re right. Everyone needs to know.
translation: 你说得对。每个人都需要知道。

source: Oooohhh… I didn’t know that was happening at all yesterday…
translation: 哦哦哦……我昨天完全不知道发生了那件事……

source: Yeah… That was a huge decision to make, and honestly Sir Goro made the right call.
translation: 是啊……那是一个重大决定，说实话 Goro先生 做出了正确选择。

source: Rebuilding other branches is a life’s worth of work.
translation: 重建其他分部是一生的工作。

source: Y-Yeah… Even this project takes so much time and effort to make happen…
translation: 是、是啊……就连这个项目都需要这么多时间和精力才能实现……

source: At first I was baffled too, but hearing just how big of an undertaking it was… It might be too much for a small group of people like us…
translation: 起初我也很困惑，但听到这是多大的工程后……对于像我们这样一小群人来说，可能负担太重……

source: I’m glad you all understand…
translation: 我很高兴你们都理解……

source: Expanding the camp we have right now is manageable, but opening another branch is a totally different story.
translation: 扩张我们现在拥有的营地还可控，但开设另一个分部则完全是另一回事。

source: We thought it would be best if we concentrated our efforts and made one perfect Camp Buddy.
translation: 我们认为集中精力打造一个完美的 Camp Buddy 会是最好的。

source: I’d also like to take this chance to tell you all something very important…
translation: 我也想借这个机会告诉大家一件非常重要的事……

source: Oh? What is it, Dad?
translation: 哦？是什么，爸爸？

source: Starting the next term, Yoshinori will be taking my place as the camp president.
translation: 从下个营期开始，Yoshinori将接替我担任营地负责人。

source: Oh my god, that’s amazing, Yoshi!
translation: 天啊，这太棒了，Yoshi！

source: Congrats.
translation: 恭喜。

source: Hehe, that sounds about right~!
translation: 嘿嘿，听起来很合适～！

source: KYAAA! This has been your dream, hasn’t it, Yoshi?!
translation: 呀啊啊！这一直是你的梦想，不是吗，Yoshi？！

source: Thank you, everyone… I promise I’ll do my best!
translation: 谢谢，大家……我保证会尽力！

source: B-But what about Sir Goro?
translation: 但、但是 Goro先生 呢？

source: Oh yeah, Gramps! Does this mean you’re officially retiring too?
translation: 哦，对，Gramps！这意味着你也正式退休了吗？

source: I will still finish my commitment to this project, but after that I’m not sure…
translation: 我仍会完成自己对这个项目的承诺，但之后我不确定……

source: One thing I know is that it’s for the best if I have some time outside of Camp Buddy.
translation: 我知道的一件事是，如果我有些时间离开 Camp Buddy，会是最好的。

source: Yay, Dad! I’m so happy you’re finally giving yourself a well-deserved break!
translation: 太好了，爸爸！我很高兴你终于给自己一个应得的休息！

source: I… don’t think I’ll come back to the job, dear.
translation: 我……我想我不会回到这份工作了，亲爱的。

source: Oh… You’re resigning permanently…?
translation: 哦……你要永久辞职……？

source: I don’t mean anything bad, but… are you sure about that, sir? I mean… this has been your life’s work!
translation: 我没有恶意，但是……您确定吗，先生？我是说……这一直是您毕生的工作！

source: Exactly, Lloyd. He’s been doing this for a long time.
translation: 正是如此，Lloyd。他做这个很久了。

source: Isn’t there a way around this? Like, you know, Gramps can just lay back and let us do all the work!
translation: 没有别的办法吗？比如说，Gramps可以放松下来，把所有工作交给我们！

source: I think that defeats the purpose. If Sir Goro sticks around, it would be in his nature to assist the camp in every way he can.
translation: 我觉得那违背了目的。如果 Goro先生 留在这里，他天性会以一切方式协助营地。

source: He won’t be able to have time for himself if that’s the case.
translation: 如果是那样，他就没法拥有自己的时间。

source: I don’t think things will be the same without Sir Goro…
translation: 我觉得没有 Goro先生，事情不会一样……

source: Come on, guys! That’s why Yoshi’s stepping up to take his place! I’m sure Dad thought all of this out!
translation: 来吧，伙计们！这就是为什么 Yoshi 会站出来接替他！我相信爸爸已经想清楚这一切！

source: Yuri’s right, everyone. Instead, we should all be grateful for all the hard work and time Goro dedicated to the camp since we were scouts!
translation: Yuri 说得对，大家。相反，我们都该感激自从我们当童子军以来，Goro 为营地投入的所有辛劳和时间！

source: Oh, of course, of course!
translation: 哦，当然，当然！

source: Well, if that’s what’ll make Gramps happy, then I guess…
translation: 嗯，如果那会让Gramps开心，那么我想……

source: Thank you for your service, Sir Goro.
translation: 感谢您的付出，Goro先生。

source: Thank you all again for understanding…
translation: 再次感谢你们所有人的理解……

source: This’ll be really good for you, Dad! You’re finally letting go of all these responsibilities! I’m so excited for your retirement!
translation: 这对你真的很好，爸爸！你终于放下所有这些责任了！我为你的退休感到兴奋！

source: And you chose the best person to pass the torch to! With Yoshi, the camp will be in good hands!
translation: 而且你选择了最适合接过火炬的人！有 Yoshi 在，营地会被照料得很好！

source: Exactly. I’m sure the camp’s future is guaranteed with Yoshinori.
translation: 正是如此。我相信有 Yoshinori 在，营地的未来有保障。

source: However, as I said earlier, I will continue to lead alongside Yoshinori for the remaining span of the project, so nothing will change until then!
translation: 不过，正如我早些时候所说，我会在项目剩余期间继续与 Yoshinori 一同领导，所以在那之前不会有什么改变！

source: We still have a long winter ahead – let’s make sure the scouts have the best version of Camp Buddy to come back to!
translation: 前面还有漫长的冬天——让我们确保童子军回来时能见到最好的 Camp Buddy！

source: Yes, sir!
translation: 是，先生！

source: Meanwhile, Aiden kept up his regular maintenance duties, but this time around he had Emilia doing most of the other chores, like cleaning and laundry.
translation: 与此同时，Aiden 继续履行日常维护职责，但这次他让 Emilia 完成大部分其他杂务，如清洁和洗衣。

source: Goro and I kept the entire project well-managed, making sure we stayed on schedule, while Yuri assisted us and Aiden’s department on the side.
translation: Goro 和我把整个项目管理得井井有条，确保按进度进行，而 Yuri 同时协助我们和 Aiden 的部门。

source: Finally, after months of hard work, we’ve all reached the project completion we’ve been aiming for.
translation: 终于，在数月辛勤工作后，我们都达成了项目预期的完成目标。

source: You’ve all worked extremely hard, and I want to express my gratitude to your dedication and commitment to seeing things through.
translation: 你们所有人都非常努力，我想表达对你们奉献及坚持完成工作的感激。

source: Thank you again, sir, for everything you’ve done, and for being here with us today.
translation: 再次感谢您，先生，感谢您所做的一切，也感谢您今天与我们在这里。

source: Lastly, I want to wish you all the best in your future endeavors. The completion of this project marks a culmination of my career here as the camp’s president.
translation: 最后，祝愿大家今后一切顺利。这个项目的完成，也为我担任营地负责人的职业生涯画上了圆满句号。

source: I continue to wish for this place’s success, and hope that Camp Buddy will prosper for many years to come.
translation: 我会继续祝愿这个地方成功，并希望 Camp Buddy 在未来多年繁荣。

source: Now, to the future and whatever it might hold.
translation: 现在，敬未来以及它可能带来的一切。

source: Regardless, this was quite the experience.
translation: 不管怎样，这是一段相当的经历。

source: Yeah! I’m sure Yoshi, Yuri, and I can sneak away from time to time!
translation: 是啊！我相信 Yoshi、Yuri 和我能时不时偷偷溜出来！

source: And Gramps is retired now, so he has all the time in the world!
translation: 而且Gramps现在退休了，所以他有大把时间！

source: Well, we’ll see. I’m not sure how often I’ll be in the area.
translation: 嗯，走着瞧。我不确定自己会多常待在这个地区。

source: Aww, if you’re around, please call us! I’d love to hear stories about your retirement!
translation: 啊，如果你在附近，请给我们打电话！我很想听听你的退休故事！

source: Unlimited vacay.
translation: 无限假期。

source: And if you ever need a ‘hand’, I’ll gladly do the ‘job’!
translation: 而且如果你需要一“把手”，我会很乐意做那份“工作”！

source: Thank you, all.
translation: 谢谢你们，大家。

source: Huhuhu!! First Lloyd, Darius, and Jin are leaving, and soon Dad too! I can’t take all of this! I’m gonna cry!
translation: 呜呜呜！！先是 Lloyd、Darius 和 Jin 要离开，很快爸爸也要走！我受不了这些！我要哭了！

source: Don’t worry, dear. You and I will still talk all the time.
translation: 别担心，亲爱的。你和我仍会经常交谈。

source: Well, I have nowhere else to be anyway… and Aiden’s gonna need all the help he can get!
translation: 嗯，反正我也没其他地方可去……而 Aiden 会需要他能得到的所有帮助！

source: Ugh, you can say that AFTER you stop spending every paycheck on fancy clothes and makeup!
translation: 唉，等你不再把每一份工资都花在华丽衣服和化妆品上后再说！

source: Hmph, I don’t see you complaining whenever I let you wear them!
translation: 哼，每当我让你穿它们时，我可没见你抱怨！

source: You know, I think I’ll even miss this bantering.
translation: 你知道，我想我甚至会想念这种斗嘴。

source: I’ll play fight with you if you want.
translation: 如果你想，我会和你打闹。

source: S-Sword fight…?
translation: 剑、剑斗……？

source: *ehem* You all don’t have to worry about us here at Camp Buddy. You have helped us more than enough, especially you, Goro.
translation: *咳哼* 你们都不用担心我们在 Camp Buddy 的情况。你们已经给了我们足够多的帮助，尤其是你，Goro。

source: Oops! There’s our shuttle! I think that’s our cue to go.
translation: 哎呀！我们的接驳车来了！我想这就是我们该走的信号。

source: Camp Buddy will always be here for ya’ll!
translation: Camp Buddy 永远会在这里等着你们所有人！

source: *sniff* Even though I’m sad to see everyone go, I guess I should congratulate you, Dad…
translation: *抽鼻子* 虽然我很难过看到大家离开，但我想我该祝贺你，爸爸……

source: Hm? What for?
translation: 嗯？为了什么？

source: Well, it is your first day of retirement now officially! You’re free to do whatever you want!
translation: 嗯，现在正式是你退休的第一天！你可以自由做任何想做的事！

source: Ah… About that.
translation: 啊……关于这个。

source: Huh? Did you suddenly change your mind or something?
translation: 嗯？你突然改变主意了还是什么？

source: No. But I think I’ll use the next few months as a chance to prepare Yoshinori here for all that awaits him.
translation: 没有。但我想我会用接下来的几个月作为机会，让这里的 Yoshinori 为等待他的一切做好准备。

source: He’s been learning plenty from me, but there’s still more to turnover before the next summer term.
translation: 他已经从我这里学到了很多，但在下个夏季营期前，仍有不少工作需要交接。

source: I’ll stick around here for now, and make sure that he has everything he needs.
translation: 我暂时会留在这里，确保他拥有所需的一切。

source: Thank you, Goro. I’ll make you proud!
translation: 谢谢你，Goro。我会让你骄傲！

source: …Right.
Alright! That delays a little bit of my sadness at least.
translation: 好！至少这稍微推迟了我的悲伤。

source: Why don’t we head to the mess hall? We can have a little snack!
translation: 我们去食堂怎么样？可以吃点小吃！

source: I suppose I could whip us something up~
translation: 我想我可以给我们快速做点什么～

source: Eugh, please don’t. Come on, you guys!
translation: 呃，请别。来吧，大家！

source: Right behind you, dear.
translation: 紧跟着你，亲爱的。

source: Hey, Yoshi! Hold up a sec.
translation: 嘿，Yoshi！等一下。

source: Oh, what is it, Aiden?
translation: 哦，什么事，Aiden？

source: Well… It’s about you and Gramps.
translation: 嗯……是关于你和Gramps。

source: I know we’ve been so busy with the project, but I haven’t got the chance to check in.
translation: 我知道我们一直忙于项目，但我没机会问问情况。

source: How have you two been doing, you know… relationship-wise?
translation: 你们两个最近怎么样，你知道的……感情方面？

source: A-Ah, well… Honestly, we haven’t been able to do much together thanks to all the work.
translation: 啊、啊，嗯……说实话，由于这么多工作，我们没能一起做多少事。

source: And by the sound of things, we’ll probably be pretty busy from now till the start of next term, too.
translation: 而且照目前的情况，从现在到下个营期开始，我们恐怕都会很忙。

source: But don’t worry, Aiden! Goro and I are going to make things work!
translation: 但别担心，Aiden！Goro 和我会让事情顺利！

source: He and I already talked about it, and we’re on the same page.
translation: 他和我已经谈过这件事，我们意见一致。

source: Alright… I just wanted to make sure.
translation: 好吧……我只是想确认。

source: Of course. Now come on, let’s catch up with the others. There’s still so much more to do!
translation: 当然。现在来吧，我们去追上其他人。还有很多事要做！

source: {i}With just a short time left before the summer term started, Goro stayed true to his word and made sure to teach me everything else I needed.{/i}
translation: {i}距离夏季营期开始已没有多少时间，Goro信守承诺，把我还需要掌握的一切都教给了我。{/i}

source: {i}It was honestly overwhelming to take it all in, and I sometimes wished it didn’t have to be this way… If only Goro would stay here…{/i}
translation: {i}说实话，要把一切都吸收实在令人不堪重负，我有时希望事情不必如此……要是 Goro 能留在这里就好了……{/i}

source: {i}But I can’t force him, and I want him to be happy too… I even tried to make the time special for us and make each day memorable as best I could.{/i}
translation: {i}但我不能强迫他，我也想让他幸福……我甚至试着让这段时光对我们特别，并尽力让每一天值得铭记。{/i}

source: {i}Aiden’s questions continued to echo in my mind, and a part of me was unsure of what would become of Goro and I after this final push…{/i}
translation: {i}Aiden 的问题持续在我脑中回响，而我内心有一部分不确定，在这最后冲刺后 Goro 和我会变成怎样……{/i}

source: {i}I just have to stay resolute, and remember that all of this is for the sake of the camp and Goro’s happiness…{/i}
translation: {i}我只必须坚定，并记住这一切都是为了营地和 Goro 的幸福……{/i}

source: {i}It will all be worth it in the end…{/i}
translation: {i}最终这一切都会值得……{/i}

source: Do you have everything you need?
translation: 你有所有需要的东西吗？

source: Yes. Yuri already scheduled a moving truck for all my stuff.
translation: 有。Yuri 已经为我所有东西安排了搬家卡车。

source: Have you said goodbye to everyone as well?
translation: 你也和所有人告别了吗？

source: Of course. Aiden was still trying to convince me to stay.
translation: 当然。Aiden 仍试图说服我留下。

source: Don’t worry, I’m sure he’ll understand eventually.
translation: 别担心，我相信他最终会理解。

source: But you must be excited that your retirement is finally here!
translation: 但你的退休终于到来，你一定很兴奋！

source: Yes. I’ve been looking forward to it, especially since we had to work the entire spring just to get everything in place for your takeover.
translation: 是的。我一直很期待，尤其是我们不得不工作整个春天，才能为你的接手安排好一切。

source: Do you have your bike fully checked and tuned up? It’s going to be a long drive to where you’re going.
translation: 你的摩托车完全检查并调校好了吗？去你要去的地方会是一段漫长车程。

source: Yeah. You don’t need to check everything for me now, Yoshinori. I can handle myself.
translation: 是的。你现在不用替我检查一切，Yoshinori。我能照顾自己。

source: Well… If you’re really going now, just don’t forget to call me, alright?
translation: 嗯……如果你现在真的要走，别忘了打电话给我，好吗？

source: O-Oh…! We should schedule a road trip, too! How about every weekend?
translation: 哦、哦……！我们也该安排一次公路旅行！每个周末怎么样？

source: *sigh* You already forgot about all the appointments you need to attend to.
translation: *叹气* 你已经忘了所有需要参加的约会。

source: The next term is only a week away. Can I really leave the camp to you like this?
translation: 距离下个营期只剩一周。我真的能放心把营地交给你吗？

source: A-Ah! Sorry about that…!
translation: 啊、啊！抱歉……！

source: I-I was just thinking that maybe when things settle down a bit during the summer, we can find time!
translation: 我、我只是想，也许夏天事情稍微安定后，我们能找到时间！

source: You know that’s not going to happen, Yoshinori.
translation: 你知道那不会发生，Yoshinori。

source: Well, maybe if you visit us here at least once a month?
translation: 嗯，也许如果你每月至少来这里看我们一次？

source: No. What I mean is… I don’t think this will work for us…
translation: 不。我想说的是……我不认为这对我们会行得通……

source: Huh…? Wh-What are you saying, Goro...?
translation: 嗯……？你、你在说什么，Goro……？

source: We had the chance the entire spring… last year… and all the time before that…
translation: 整个春天……去年……以及此前所有时间，我们都有机会……

source: And it’s given me more than enough time to think about us…
translation: 这给了我足够多的时间思考我们……

source: Ever since we started dating, I started having these plans, and dreams for our future…
translation: 自从我们开始约会后，我就开始拥有这些计划，以及对未来的梦想……

source: But I realized it was a mistake, all along…
translation: 但我意识到这一直是个错误……

source: Let’s admit it… Being partners was never meant for us…
translation: 承认吧……我们从来都不该成为伴侣……

source: W-Wait, you can’t be serious…
translation: 等、等等，你不是认真的……

source: We’ve had all these experiences together... all these chances... and we still ended up in the same place as before…
translation: 我们一起有过所有这些经历……所有这些机会……而我们仍回到和以前相同的地方……

source: I want us to be more… And that’s not possible.
translation: 我想让我们有更多……而这不可能。

source: G-Goro..! I-I’m so sorry! Wh-What have I done wrong…?! And what can I do to make this right?!
translation: G-Goro……！我、我很抱歉！我、我做错了什么……？！我又能做什么来改正？！

source: That’s not the case, Yoshinori… I’ve made up my mind already.
translation: 不是那样，Yoshinori……我已经下定决心。

source: I’m making this choice for myself… I need to prove that I can find happiness on my own without attaching it to the camp… attaching it to you…
translation: 我为了自己做出这个选择……我需要证明自己能独自找到幸福，而不把它依附于营地……依附于你……

source: I’ve spent my whole life giving up everything until there was nothing left to give.
translation: 我花费整个人生放弃一切，直到再也没有东西可放弃。

source: It’s time for me to find myself again.
translation: 是我重新找回自己的时候了。

source: So, please. The last thing I’ll ask of you is to understand and set me free…
translation: 所以，请你。我要拜托你的最后一件事，就是理解并让我自由……

source: I understand, Goro…
translation: 我明白，Goro……

source: *hugs Yoshinori*
translation: *拥抱 Yoshinori*

source: I’ll keep in touch… And I’ll make time if the camp needs my help.
translation: 我会保持联系……如果营地需要我的帮助，我会腾出时间。

source: But I know all of you will do your best.
translation: 但我知道你们所有人都会尽力。

source: Y-Yes, sir…
translation: 是、是的，先生……

source: Goodbye, Yoshinori.
translation: 再见，Yoshinori。

source: Goodbye, Goro…
translation: 再见，Goro……

source: {i}(I stood at the arches of Camp Buddy as I watched Goro drive away…){/i}
translation: {i}（我站在 Camp Buddy 的拱门前，看着 Goro 驾车离开……）{/i}

source: {i}(Left to wonder about the choices I’ve made… the only right thing I knew was to respect his decision and let him go…){/i}
translation: {i}（我只能思考自己做出的选择……我知道唯一正确的事就是尊重他的决定，让他离开……）{/i}

source: {i}(Even though I thought we had gained so much throughout the seasons… In the end what I lost was more important.){/i}
translation: {i}（尽管我以为在这些日子里收获了许多……到最后，我失去的更重要。）{/i}

source: {i}(My only hope now is for Goro to be truly happy out there… and that maybe one day he’ll come back for good…){/i}
translation: {i}（我现在唯一的希望，是 Goro 能在外面真正幸福……也许有一天会永远回来……）{/i}
